name: Euro stacking container 600 x 400 x 340 mm
description:
A solid-walled euro stacking container on the 600 x 400 mm footprint, in the deep 340 mm height. The footprint is the standard European small load carrier module, four of which fill a 1200 x 800 mm Euro pallet layer exactly; the extra height makes this the bulk-storage member of the family, used where the 230 mm crate runs out of volume before it runs out of weight.

External dimensions: length 600 mm, width 400 mm, height 340 mm.

600 x 400 mm footprint: the standard euro container module, four per 1200 x 800 mm Euro pallet layer. Same grid as the VDA 4500 small load carrier family.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 2,816 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: Euro stacking container, 600 x 400 x 340 mm - true-scale GLB of the deep variant of the standard European small load carrier.
